{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Injected Recovery Evaluation — run all 3 model variants
# Usage: bash scripts/run_injected_eval.sh [taxei|random|vanilla|all|compare]
set -e

cd /root/autodl-tmp/tax_error_inject_agent
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

BASEM=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-8B
mkdir -p eval_results

# Find latest checkpoint: find_final_ckpt <ckpt_root>
find_final_ckpt() {
    local ckpt_root=$1
    local latest_run
    latest_run=$(ls -dt "$ckpt_root"/v*-*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -z "$latest_run" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: no run dir in $ckpt_root" >&2; return 1
    fi
    local final
    final=$(ls -d "$latest_run"/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)
    if [ -z "$final" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: no checkpoint in $latest_run" >&2; return 1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$final/adapter_config.json" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: $final missing adapter_config.json" >&2; return 1
    fi
    echo "$final"
}

SEED=${SEED:-42}
NUM_EPS=${NUM_EPISODES:-47}
INJ_STEP=${INJECT_STEP:--1}

run_variant() {
    local variant=$1
    local ckpt_root=$2
    local gpu=$3

    local ckpt
    ckpt=$(find_final_ckpt "$ckpt_root")
    echo "[$variant] checkpoint: $ckpt"
    echo "[$variant] GPU: cuda:$gpu"

    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python eval/injected_eval.py \
        --model_path "$ckpt" \
        --base_model "$BASEM" \
        --model_variant "$variant" \
        --output "eval_results/injected_${variant}.json" \
        --device cuda:0 \
        --seed "$SEED" \
        --num_episodes "$NUM_EPS" \
        --inject_step "$INJ_STEP"
}

run_taxei()   { run_variant taxei   checkpoints/mini_taxei_sft_v4   0; }
run_random()  { run_variant random  checkpoints/mini_random_sft_v4  1; }
run_vanilla() { run_variant vanilla checkpoints/mini_vanilla_sft_v4 2; }

run_compare() {
    echo "=== TaxEI vs Vanilla ==="
    python eval/injected_eval.py \
        --output eval_results/injected_taxei.json \
        --compare_with eval_results/injected_vanilla.json \
        --compare_output eval_results/compare_taxei_vs_vanilla.json

    echo ""
    echo "=== Random vs Vanilla ==="
    python eval/injected_eval.py \
        --output eval_results/injected_random.json \
        --compare_with eval_results/injected_vanilla.json \
        --compare_output eval_results/compare_random_vs_vanilla.json

    echo ""
    echo "=== TaxEI vs Random ==="
    python eval/injected_eval.py \
        --output eval_results/injected_taxei.json \
        --compare_with eval_results/injected_random.json \
        --compare_output eval_results/compare_taxei_vs_random.json
}

case "${1:-all}" in
    taxei)   run_taxei ;;
    random)  run_random ;;
    vanilla) run_vanilla ;;
    compare) run_compare ;;
    all)
        run_taxei &
        PID_T=$!
        run_random &
        PID_R=$!
        run_vanilla &
        PID_V=$!
        echo "Running all 3 variants in parallel (taxei=$PID_T, random=$PID_R, vanilla=$PID_V)..."
        wait $PID_T && echo "[taxei] done"   || echo "[taxei] FAILED"
        wait $PID_R && echo "[random] done"  || echo "[random] FAILED"
        wait $PID_V && echo "[vanilla] done" || echo "[vanilla] FAILED"
        echo ""
        run_compare
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: bash scripts/run_injected_eval.sh [taxei|random|vanilla|all|compare]"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
